## Scores

<div id="fsp-list"></div>

Any piece in the [Analysed Scores Library](view.qmd) also opens here, Roman numerals and all: the **Full score** button on its page,
e.g. [Beethoven, "Moonlight" Sonata, I](?analysed=beethoven-sonata-14-1).

<div id="fsp-head"></div>
<div id="fsp"></div>

## How to use a score

- **Play** (or Space) plays from the start, from a clicked note, or from a bar typed in the **Bar** box; Space again pauses.
- **Choose instruments** shows and plays only some of the orchestra; views can be saved by name.
- **Layout**: pages scrolling down, pages side by side (◀ ▶ or the arrow keys turn them), or one long line; bar numbers; bar lines through
  each family or the whole score; staff spacing even or kept apart; size, bar width and page height. Your layout is kept in this browser.
- **Even out the loudness** brings soft and loud passages, and solos and tutti, closer together, for hearing inner parts.

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var BASE = "/apps/shared/data/full-scores/", V = "1";
  var id = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("id");
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]; }); }
  // an Analysed Scores Library piece (?analysed=<id>): its ABC turned into the full-score form (bare V: lines, each voice's music on one
  // line, named instruments: name= kept, the first unnamed voice is "Piano" and the voices after it belong to it)
  var LIB = "/apps/shared/data/scores/", LV = "4", an = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("analysed");
  // ?bar=N (from a Classical Theme's "Full score from bar N"): go there once the score is mounted
  var goTo = parseInt(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("bar"), 10);
  function mounted(sc) { window.score = sc; if (!isNaN(goTo)) (function tryGo(n) { if (document.querySelector("#fsp .fs-paper svg")) sc.goBar(goTo); else if (n < 100) setTimeout(function () { tryGo(n + 1); }, 100); })(0); }
  function toFull(abc) {
    var head = [], body = [], named = false;
    abc.replace(/\r/g, "").split("\n").forEach(function (ln) {
      var b = /^\[V:(\S+)\]\s*(.*)$/.exec(ln);
      if (b) { body.push("V:" + b[1], b[2]); return; }
      if (/^V:\S+/.test(ln)) {
        if (/ name="/.test(ln)) { ln = ln.replace(/ name="/, ' nm="'); named = true; }
        else if (named !== "piano") { ln += ' nm="Piano"'; named = "piano"; }
      }
      if (ln.trim()) head.push(ln);
    });
    return head.concat(body).join("\n") + "\n";
  }
  if (an) {
    an = an.replace(/[^\w-]/g, "");
    fetch(LIB + "index.json?v=" + LV).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (index) {
      var p = index.filter(function (x) { return x.id === an; })[0];
      if (!p) throw new Error("no piece called " + an);
      return fetch(LIB + p.file + ".json?v=" + LV).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (B) {
        var d = B[an];
        document.title = p.title + " – full score";
        document.getElementById("fsp-head").innerHTML = "<h2>" + esc(p.title) + "</h2><p>" + esc(p.sub + " · " + p.key + " · " + p.meter) +
          ' · Analysis: ' + esc(d.who) + ' · <a href="view.html?id=' + encodeURIComponent(an) + '">the analysed score page</a></p>';
        mounted(FullScore.mount("#fsp", { abc: toFull(d.abc), id: "an-" + an }));
      });
    }).catch(function (e) { document.getElementById("fsp-head").textContent = "The analysed score did not load: " + e.message; });
  }
  fetch(BASE + "index.json?v=" + V).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (list) {
    document.getElementById("fsp-list").innerHTML = "<ul>" + list.map(function (s) {
      return '<li><a href="?id=' + encodeURIComponent(s.id) + '">' + esc(s.composer + ": " + s.title + ", " + s.movement) + '</a><br><span class="fsp-sub">' + esc(s.orchestra) + "</span></li>";
    }).join("") + "</ul>";
    var s = list.filter(function (x) { return x.id === id; })[0];
    if (!s || an) return;
    document.getElementById("fsp-head").innerHTML = "<h2>" + esc(s.composer + ": " + s.title) + "</h2><p>" + esc(s.movement + " · " + s.orchestra) + "</p>";
    return Promise.all([fetch(BASE + s.abc + "?v=" + V).then(function (r) { return r.text(); }), s.notes ? fetch(BASE + s.notes + "?v=" + V).then(function (r) { return r.text(); }) : ""])
      .then(function (a) { mounted(FullScore.mount("#fsp", { abc: a[0], id: s.id, notes: a[1] })); });
  }).catch(function (e) { document.getElementById("fsp-list").textContent = "The score list did not load: " + e.message; });
})();
</script>
```
